cards.name: Hợp Đồng Hết Hạn Trong 30 Ngày

native.query: SELECT contract_number, title, end_date, total_value FROM pro_contracts WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND end_date BETWEEN NOW() AND NOW() + INTERVAL '30 days' AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY end_date
